Audited production baseline: `origin/master@4fccc57ec73ce54827167dddc5bbafac41ae66d2`.
Candidate/probe base: `5a8167d0b`, including the separately approved readback repair `44a5f88fb`.
Binding independent rulings: [startup/continuation class](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2498#issuecomment-5902935619) and latest [P16 standing-authority repair: insufficient; widen class](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2498#issuecomment-5903522698).
**Approved for bounded implementation, not merge:** [final independent gate](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2498#issuecomment-5903816439). All P01-P16/M/U/RB proof obligations and gate conditions remain binding. The frozen request below records the reviewed design, not current implementation status.

[5906100464](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2498#issuecomment-5906100464)
supersedes the process freeze recorded below. Final implementation/proof status
is in `issue-2498-postimplementation.md`; earlier counterexamples remain evidence.

Implementation placement addendum: the unchanged StandingRestart model and sole ClassifyStandingRestart decision table move from the pipeline composition package to the existing run-lifecycle domain so delivery persistence can consume the canonical reader without a delivery -> pipeline -> bus dependency cycle. Every consumer is migrated directly; no old alias, duplicate classifier or new authority/framework is introduced. The selected-store standingdisposition reader and standing desired-state writer retain their existing authority and transaction order.

Implementation stop addendum: the independent process ruling at issuecomment-5905422933 is `insufficient; widen class`. `issue-2498-standing-operator-composition-preimplementation.md` supersedes the reset-only stop with the complete durable-state x child-presence command/compensation matrix and S01-S17. Fresh repeat suspend/resume and valid no-child terminal/invalid reset are not optional follow-ups. Process-lifetime coding remains frozen for one focused re-gate. Candidate pause/restart and continue refusal proof does not close those earlier gates; the prior approval remains evidence within scope.

This additive amendment supersedes the paused-stop artifact's proposed recovery-disabled workaround and the prior P01-P15 claim that a paused control row alone proves operator run.pause authority. P16 absorbs the standing pause producers and their generic-continue consumer into the same chosen class. The original corpus audit, 23 M rows/U1-U5 and four readback rows remain required, not restarted or credited by these probes. No production code, authoritative runtime semantics, original #2008 WIP, external handover, provider traffic or test framework changed in this audit.

## Classification And Binding Context

- Category: semantic drift / executable-work eligibility / SQLite-PostgreSQL parity, reached through supported e2e regression coverage.
- Symptom: after public pause at 32/100 issued, 68 owed, 32 events and 32 nonterminal deliveries, retained recovery-enabled startup refuses readiness. The six supported process executions already recorded are the entry point, not the audit boundary.
- Additional execution-proven manifestation: the continuation scanner selects paused handed pending/failed/stale-in-progress agent work; actual AgentManager `OnEvent` executes and delivers before continue. Direct continuation dispatch through the real Pipeline/engine also authors a node event while paused.
- Additional mechanical counterexample: acknowledged handed-only continue examines zero pipeline candidates and sends zero notifications to the installed real continuation owner on both stores. Successful public wake remains a required post-repair proof; the probe does not start a coordinator that cannot yet park correctly.
- Additional same-concept parity manifestation: PostgreSQL rejects continue without operator control; SQLite manufactures running control from lifecycle `paused` alone. Existing materialized-like paused API coverage is PostgreSQL-only.
- P16 same-concept producer/consumer defect: standing suspend, suspension-preserving reset and orphaning also write paired paused lifecycle/control. Disposable selected-store probes reproduce generic continue committing running while retained standing authority becomes invalid_current, all three variants count3 on both stores. Public CLI/RPC refusal and supported standing.resume are still required repair proofs, not claimed baseline evidence.
- Exact concepts: active/reconstructable versus executable-now run state; ordinary operator pause versus standing-owned desired state; fresh pipeline/delivery admission; retained continuation ownership and post-continue wake. Do not redefine causal execution mode, topology ownership, receipt/handoff semantics, terminal settlement or fork authority.
- Added chosen class: **pause-aware executable-work eligibility across startup, continuations and public continue**, including provenance parity and canonical standing pause authority. This PR aims to eliminate that complete class, not only remove a startup error. Existing corpus/readback classes also remain complete-closure obligations.
- Immediate runtime parent: delivery/recovery admission and continuation ownership. Broader runtime parent: generation-scoped executable lifecycle composition (#2250/watchlist). Coverage parent: #2407's reusable acceptance/merge-gate program.
- Framing: old startup-only framing is too narrow. This repaired class is broad enough and finite; do not absorb all delivery/replay, startup orchestration, performance or selected-fork capabilities.

Exact governing sections re-read:

1. `platform-spec.yaml#run_model.lifecycle.pause_resume`, `api_specification.method_catalog["run.pause"]` and `["run.continue"]`: halt new dispatch and permit already-dispatched handlers to complete. Ordinary continue must consume committed run control together with exact-current standing authority; a paused control row is shared state, not a producer certificate.
2. `platform_tables.tables.run_control_state` and `platform_tables.tables.runs.terminal_evidence.continue_post_commit_recovery`: persisted control distinguishes fork-materialized pause; the transition commits before recovery; post-commit failure cannot invite transition replay.
3. `durable_pipeline_processing_obligation_authority.claim_contract.{recovery,scan,scan_blockage,startup_blockage_evidence,scan_result,startup_timer_handoff,startup_creation_handoff}`: bounded membership/cursors, fresh eligibility, remembered genuine blockers, explicit exhaustion, exact cleanup and ordered handoff.
4. `process_local_work_lifetime_authority.durable_handoff.delivery_continuation`: one exact generation/carrier/attempt authority, explicit return/consume/terminal resolution, joined retirement, no polling workaround.
5. `engine.dynamic_instance_lifecycle.creation.route_materialization` and `cli_specification.command_catalog.serve`: active paused topology reconstruction remains mandatory; runnable pipeline work settles before continuation release, autonomous producers and public readiness.
6. Startup recovery-disabled admission and typed delivery inventory, `durable_data_resources.deployment_origin`, fan-out serving grant/run eligibility and selected-fork control restrictions remain binding.
7. `flow_model.flow_instance_authoring.standing_activation_model.lifecycle_authority`, `platform_tables.tables.standing_services` and `.standing_service_generations`, `api_specification.method_catalog["standing.suspend"]`, `["standing.resume"]`, `["standing.reset"]` and `cli_specification.command_catalog.standing_{suspend,resume,reset}`: only standing.resume clears durable suspension. Generic run.pause remains run-scoped and active_intrinsic reconcile may normalize it. Exact current pointer, generation relation, declaration and override are canonical authority, not control reason or actor strings. The declared policy is preserved, but its shared pause producers and generic-continue consumer are **same chosen class**, not excluded as different standing policy. YAML lookup independently verified these exact paths; the prior shorthand API path is corrected, not new spec authority.

The existing spec says all remembered `Blocked`, including run dispatch blockage, refuses startup while also supporting pause/continue. The proposed clarification below moves lawful operator-paused debt outside **runnable** selection, not outside debt inventory. An arbitrary dispatch refusal is never evidence of lawful parking. This contradiction is submitted for approval rather than silently resolved. Guidelines and SEMANTIC_DRIFT were re-read.

P16's additional full public path is: admitted active standing declaration and exact N -> compiled CLI/public RPC standing.suspend -> existing gateway/manager withdrawal and admitted-work drain -> desired-state transaction persists paused run/control plus suspended override -> public run.continue selects N's context and performs posture/fork admission -> transaction-local canonical standing disposition refuses generic release without changing N, control, override or completion candidate -> public standing.resume clears the override through the same desired-state transaction -> committed exact N is published before gateway admission reopens -> new work becomes executable. The suspend/continue/resume/reset/orphan gates are all same chosen class; source selection, authentication, execution posture and selected-fork admission retain their separately proven contracts. Reset inserts N+1 and its exact current relation before applying retained suspension; orphaning removes the declaration and publication but keeps its run/control paused. Neither step creates generic-continue authority. Invalid, terminal and historical predecessor refusal must be checked before recovery/release or ordinary execution; they are not parked ordinary work.

## One Eligibility Contract, Without A New Owner

The existing run-lifecycle/control owner remains authority for run lifecycle/control. The existing standing desired-state owner and `standingdisposition.ReadByRun` -> `pipeline.ClassifyStandingRestart` remain authority for exact-current standing permission. Generic continue and ordinary eligibility must consume **both** owners, not interpret a paired paused row as proof of its producer. Extend existing closed admission as needed; do not create a scheduler, execution registry, queue, ledger or parallel standing/pause classifier. `runstate.Active` and shared `ActiveStateSQLValues` retain running **and paused** for topology, outstanding debt and allowed in-flight settlement. Execution selectors and claim entrances must consume the separate canonical dispatch classification, not change the universal active set to running.

| Persisted / authority posture | Topology / debt | New ordinary execution / startup |
|---|---|---|
| running, absent or running operator control, valid normal and standing authority | Reconstruct and retain | Runnable; posture/source/generation/materialization and exact-current standing disposition still checked |
| paused with paired paused control and standing disposition ordinary, or active_intrinsic with no standing override | Reconstruct and retain unchanged debt | Parked; no new pipeline/delivery attempt, node handler or agent OnEvent until admitted continue. Active intrinsic reconciliation retains its separately specified normalization |
| paused without operator control, fork/materialization state | Preserve exact fork evidence | Not ordinary continue authority or normal-runtime permission; only existing exact fork activation/execution rules may authorize it |
| completed/failed/cancelled/forked or stopped control | Existing terminal/lineage rules | No new execution; terminal fence/cleanup is not pause parking |
| contradictory, unknown, absent-parent or malformed source/control/authority | Diagnose through existing validation | Fail closed, never silently classified as paused or excluded as harmless |
| global runtime ingress paused | Separate persisted ingress owner | Existing global startup refusal remains; a run-local parking rule cannot override it |
| standing exact-current suspended, including reset-preserved N+1 | Canonical current pointer/generation/declaration/override and StandingRunRestartDisposition | No generic continue, ordinary runnable classification or parked-to-running release. Only existing standing.resume clears suspension; reset retains it |
| standing exact-current orphaned, terminal_declared/terminal_orphaned, invalid_current or unprovable relation | Retain existing typed service-local evidence; malformed relations fail closed | No ordinary continue/recovery/work authority; use existing restore/reset remediation. Never treat inconsistent standing state as harmless operator parking |
| standing active_intrinsic with generic run.pause, versus noncurrent historical lineage | Canonical exact-current projection; active historical lineage remains generic per the existing spec | Preserve generic pause/continue and reconciliation normalization for active intrinsic with no override. A reset-retired terminal predecessor remains refused by lifecycle/control; do not ban every standing-origin run |
| runless allowed platform/control work | Existing origin/source rules | Unchanged explicit platform policy, not an inferred running run |

Pause versus claim must linearize through existing admission/selected-store ownership. A pipeline candidate snapshot or carrier acquired before pause is not proof of an executable delivery attempt. Recheck before new route dispatch and at the exact durable agent/node claim, under the existing parent-run transaction fence. A claim that actually won before pause is already in flight and may finish; its later queued recipients/follow-ups must respect the new pause. If pause wins, return/retain the exact continuation without incrementing attempts, retries or errors, fabricating receipts or losing wake. Preserve parent-before-delivery lock order and do not hold a run lock throughout handler execution.

Normal-source startup authority adoption is still necessary. Compare parked executable facts after that explicit generation adoption; only the required authority/generation rebind and predecessor-attempt expiry may differ from the pre-death snapshot. During the subsequent paused scan/dispatch interval, event bytes, feed cursor, routes, receipts, handoff markers, claim versions, retry/final selection/error facts must be identical. Do not call an expected generation rebind business execution or waive unexplained mutations.

P16 transaction order: standing suspend/resume/reset/reconcile loads and, on PostgreSQL, locks the standing parent first (`loadStandingServiceTx`/complete-set `FOR UPDATE OF ss`), then takes the existing exact run/source/lifecycle guard and mutates run/control; reset installs the successor relation/current pointer before pausing N+1. SQLite serializes this through its existing selected-store write transaction. Generic run control already locks the run first and the stop path consumes the **non-locking** `standingdisposition.ReadByRun` in that transaction. The bounded continue repair should use that same canonical read while retaining the exact run fence; standing writers cannot commit a run/control transition through that fence concurrently. Do not acquire a standing parent FOR UPDATE after locking its run: that would invert the standing-parent -> run order. If an implementation needs both locks, acquire parent before run and revalidate exact current membership in the same transaction. Continue-vs-suspend/reset/orphan deterministic races must prove the ordered result and no stale-pointer permission. No application check before the transaction, lock across runtime drain/handler execution, or reason/actor string matcher is authority.

Every known production consumer is classified; facade/generated forwarders delegate, not independent interpreters.

| Owner / consumer family | Disposition and concrete entrance |

Move SQLite `continueRunControlTx` to paired control parity and move **both** stores to consume canonical exact-current standing disposition before transition. PostgreSQL paired-control check is not sufficient standing provenance; no materialized-like control upsert |

| Delivery `Adapter.ScanContinuations`, both ordinary and selected authority arms | Move normal runnable projection; selected arm retains exact current selected-execution fence. Paused normal work must not be scheduled as executable; held entries must remain owned and re-observable |

Keep fan-out turn wake/candidate evidence under its existing owner; no pipeline receipt re-dispatch |

Census used repo-wide callsites for `PauseRunControlOutcome`, `ContinueRunControlOutcome`, `RunDispatchBlocked`, `ClaimDelivery`, `ScanDeliveryContinuations`, `DispatchDeliveryContinuation`, `ReleaseRunQueue`, `SignalDeliveryContinuations`, `StatePaused`, `run_control_state` and active SQL predicates. The P16 repair repeats **all non-test run_control_state SQL writers**, finding run-control, standing desired-state and terminal quiescence families, and classifies every standing suspend/resume/reset/reconcile/orphan entrance. Important private files: `runlifecycle/run_control{,_sqlite}.go`, `runstate/active_guard.go`, `pipelinepersistence/{owner_operations,standing_service}.go`, `standingdisposition/reader.go`, `delivery/{adapter,lifecycle}.go`; runtime bus publish/routing/sweeper, continuation coordinator, manager runtime, workflow-node delivery, run-control Controller and runtime startup diagnostics/managed composition. The previously omitted delivered-work, SQLite command and standing producer/continue interpreters are absorbed, not split or left behind.

Invalid old paths: using active lifecycle as new-execution proof; selecting paused debt as a required runnable startup blocker; scheduling handed deliveries without fresh pause admission; SQLite continue creating its own authority; paired paused control or reason/actor strings substituting for canonical standing authority; generic continue releasing a standing-owned suspension/orphan; relying on an empty pipeline sweep to wake continuations. Surviving authoritative paths: active topology/debt inventory, in-flight settlement, selected fork fence, standing desired-state/disposition owners, explicit failed/blocked recovery and existing generation cleanup. No compatibility, schema, migration, new abstraction or old-store preservation.

The P01-P16 names are supplemental to, not replacements for, M01-M23/U1-U5 and RB1-RB4. The required supported surface is the unchanged compiled CLI/RPC, real serving generations and exact public facts; component fixtures alone cannot qualify P07/P08/P16/public continue. Agent evidence is an actual recording Agent.OnEvent, not paid-provider or live-server credit. Node evidence is actual engine execution, not a mocked callback. No passing baseline counterexample is reported as a repair.

P16 exact proof obligations, all on both stores:

Proof composition is the existing `internal/releasee2e` compiled H (`buildOwnedMockLifecycleBinary`/shared serve composition), public compiled CLI and real authenticated `/v1/rpc`, reusing `prepareFullLifecycleProject` and the existing `testdata/full_lifecycle/standing_telegram` declared standing source in disposable project/store epochs. No edits to the original #2008 worktree, second harness or external runtime-credit owner. Credit is retained internal mock lifecycle plus real public operator surfaces, not live Claude/Telegram/provider proof or all #2008 rows. Existing typed store readers after joined child stop supplement public facts; a store-only setup cannot replace the claimed public suspend/refuse/resume chain.

1. Through the existing compiled process harness and authenticated real listener, create an active standing N, suspend via real compiled CLI/public RPC, then attempt generic run.continue through both surfaces. Require an actual ownership/state refusal response and nonzero CLI exit, not timeout, lost listener, unrelated internal exception or false OK; existing canonical remediation teaches standing.resume where applicable. Snapshot current pointer/generation/declaration/override and actor/reason/time, run status/control/completion candidate, journal, events/deliveries and routes before/after: domain facts unchanged, no queue release/signal/execution or manufactured running authority. Ordinary failed-operation/idempotency observation evidence is not a standing-domain mutation. Test both custom operator reason text and keyed/unkeyed calls; no producer identity inferred from the text.
2. On an independently suspended N, public standing.resume succeeds, clears override through the desired-state owner, retains exact N/service/entity identity, produces running control and active_intrinsic disposition, requests the existing immediate completion candidate and republishes its exact executable targets before gateway reopen. Verify real work can execute and retry/idempotency does not duplicate resume or work. This is supported release proof, not a direct store call or an already-corrupted state repaired manually.
3. Public suspension -> standing.reset preserves suspended N+1 and retires terminal N; generic continue cannot release N+1 or resurrect N. Retained restart preserves current suspension; only public standing.resume releases N+1. Public reads plus canonical typed selected-store snapshots prove the same pointer and control facts.
4. Declaration removal -> orphan remains paused and generic continue/resume refuses until its declared restore/reset policy permits action. Invalid current, terminal_declared/terminal_orphaned, missing/broken/foreign generation relation and stale historical predecessor fail closed with no mutation/release. Historical **noncurrent** lineage still receives canonical ordinary disposition; do not substitute an all-standing-origin ban. Existing real reset creates the terminal historical refusal control.
5. Keep active_intrinsic public run.pause/ordinary continue valid with no standing override, and retained reconcile's same-N normalization intact. This distinguishes ordinary generic pause from durable standing suspension and prevents an over-broad ban on standing runs.
6. Deterministic continue-versus-suspend/resume/reset/orphan races at existing transaction fences require parent/run ordering, exact current revalidation, complete rollback and no invalid_current mixed commit. A legitimately earlier generic continue may finish before a later suspension; after suspension commits, generic continue cannot reopen it. Completion/candidate/cleanup evidence follows the committed outcome, not caller cancellation. Do not acquire inverted locks or replace the public proof with a store-only race.

## Proposed Authoritative Spec Delta For Approval

Implementation must update `platform-spec.yaml` in the same PR; this draft alone is not a merge artifact.

1. Clarify pause_resume/run_control_state and `api_specification.method_catalog["run.continue"]`: `active` permits reconstruction and existing owned settlement, not new execution. Ordinary continue requires lifecycle paused **and** persisted control paused on both stores **and** canonical standing authority permitting generic release (ordinary, or active_intrinsic without override). Fork-materialized state or paired control alone is insufficient. Suspended, orphaned, terminal or invalid exact-current standing authority refuses generic release without changing domain facts; public callers receive refusal, never false success.
2. Amend pipeline claim_contract recovery/scan/scan_blockage/startup evidence: lawful operator-paused ordinary debt is non-runnable and retained; only runnable candidates enter startup exhaustion. A pause race receives owner-backed parked classification, not arbitrary Blocked suppression. Unexpected refusal of a running candidate, busy claims, malformed authority, retry blockage and global ingress pause still refuse readiness.
3. Add pause consumption to durable delivery continuation/claim contract: normal handed pending/failed/stale work stays owned, no new attempt or recipient effects while paused; typed parked retention is not terminality, failure or successful delivery. Fresh store admission and existing parent-run lock order resolve races. Exact selected/fork authority and already-in-flight settlement remain unchanged.
4. Extend existing continue_post_commit_recovery with exact-generation continuation notification even when pipeline examined=0, plus existing fan-out wake. Signals follow committed transition and cannot be lost to caller cancellation; errors retain committed-transition evidence and ordinary retry/idempotency rules. No new queue or recovery result owner.
5. Clarify source-scoped startup order: mandatory reconstruction of running/paused topology -> runnable pipeline unblocked exhaustion -> runnable continuation start/sync -> existing autonomous producers -> readiness. Recovery-disabled retained debt still refuses, independent of pause; global ingress remains separate.
6. Make the existing standing lifecycle section and standing/run method/CLI contracts explicit: suspend/reset-preserved suspension and orphaning share paused run/control but not ordinary-continue permission; only standing.resume clears durable override, while orphan/invalid/terminal states consume their existing restore/reset remediation. Generic pause/continue on a valid active_intrinsic declaration remains run-scoped and reconcile may normalize it without advancing N. Classify exact current versus historical identity through the existing reader and retain parent-before-run lock order. Preserve accepted-prefix fan-out commit, terminal/fork control restrictions and fresh-store-only policy; no grammar, startup reorder or unsupported fork permission.
